1. **[blocking][issue-impact][high]** `crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_plan.rs:471` gives every `non-terminal-target` the same “update to done or reject” guidance. For a container already `Archived` from `InProgress` (or any non-terminal origin), both actions are refused by the revive guard; it must first revive to its recorded origin. The same invalid advice is serialized into plan JSON and used by execution errors, so REQ-05 is unmet. Add origin-aware guidance and cover archived-from-nonterminal container and document-owner cases.

2. **[blocking][issue-impact][medium]** `crates/jit/src/output.rs:1442` says `unmet_dependencies` is empty only when dependencies are `Done`/`Rejected`, omitting terminal-origin `Archived`. This prose is emitted by `jit --schema`, while runtime filtering at line 1508 correctly treats such dependencies as met. The machine-readable contract is therefore inconsistent with the implemented status projection. [@/invariant/single-source-prose]
